about: Transcripts for evaluating the AI coach (python -m evals.coach). on_topic is the human judgement; thin means there is too little to rewrite without placeholders.

cases.transcript: Hi, I'm Priya. I just finished my degree in electronics from a college in Chennai. During my final year I built a small weather station with a Raspberry Pi that posted readings to a website every ten minutes. I enjoy hardware and coding, and now I want to join a team where I can work on real products and keep learning.

form.custom_prompt: Tell me about a time you failed.

cases.transcript: Um, I failed once, but I learned from it and now I am better.

form.custom_prompt: Why do you want to work here?

cases.transcript: Yesterday I watched the cricket final with my friends. It was a very close match and our team won in the last over, so we celebrated until midnight.

form.custom_prompt: Tell me about a time you improved a process.

cases.transcript: In my internship the team was entering sales data by hand every Friday. I wrote a small Python script that pulled the numbers from the billing system, and it cut the work from about three hours to twenty minutes. My manager asked me to show it to two other teams.

form.custom_prompt: How would you explain a surprising trend in a dashboard to a manager?

cases.transcript: First I would check the data is right, like whether a filter changed or some data is missing. Then I would tell the manager in simple words what changed, show one chart that makes it clear, and say what I think is causing it and what we could do next.

Umbrellas are one of those inventions we never think about until it rains. A good umbrella keeps you dry, but it can also keep you cool in the summer sun. Some folding ones fit in a pocket, and the big golf ones can cover two people. The worst feeling is when the wind flips it inside out.
Gardening is my favourite hobby. Every morning I water my tomato plants and check the flowers, and it helps me feel calm before college.

form.custom_prompt: Pitch yourself for your dream internship

cases.transcript: Hi, I'm Rahul, a third-year computer science student who loves turning messy data into clear stories. Last semester I built a dashboard that helped our college canteen cut food waste. I'd love to bring that same curiosity to your analytics team this summer. Could we set up a short call next week?

form.custom_prompt: Social media does more harm than good

cases.transcript: I believe social media does more harm than good. It is designed to keep us scrolling, which eats into sleep and study time. It also spreads rumours faster than facts. Some people say it helps us stay connected, but real friendships need real time together, not likes.

My favourite season is the monsoon. The first rain after a hot summer smells amazing, everything turns green, and there is nothing better than hot tea and snacks while it pours outside.
